## Quarto

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(palmerpenguins)


penguins |>
  group_by(species) |> 
  summarise(
    mean_length = mean(bill_length_mm, na.rm = TRUE),
  )
```

## Plot

```{r}
penguins |>
  ggplot(mapping = aes(x = sex, y = flipper_length_mm, fill = sex)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(x = "Sex", y = "Flipper Length")
```
